stemMd: A rectangular room is represented in a one-point perspective with its back wall parallel to the picture plane. Which group of lines normally converges to the single vanishing point?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Edges perpendicular to the back wall

options.label: B
options.textMd: Vertical edges lying within the back wall

options.label: D
options.textMd: Horizontal edges lying within the back wall

explanationMd: The depth edges run perpendicular to the back wall and recede from the viewer. They share one vanishing point. Edges parallel to the picture plane do not converge to that finite point.

distractorRationale.d: These are parallel to the picture plane and remain parallel.
distractorRationale.b: These remain vertical in the stated standard setup.
distractorRationale.e: Only one family of receding parallel lines shares this point.
distractorRationale.c: Vanishing points concern projected directions of straight lines.
